agentProfiles.name: 调研（中书）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: google
harness: antigravity
write: task-read-only; before/after HEAD, tracked and untracked diff-check; full-access is not a sandbox
use: 按问题查事实、代码入口、现状与选项，可起草 Proposal 内容
not: 不写产品代码，不代替架构决策
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/templates/author.md

agentProfiles.name: 架构（翰林）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: anthropic
harness: claude
write: assigned contract paths in worktree; auto is not read-only
use: 需求边界、共享接口、SCEN 与契约；仲裁具体契约冲突
not: 不审自己的契约，不重开已确认选项
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/templates/author.md

agentProfiles.name: 开发（工部）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: deepseek
harness: claude
write: assigned Write scope in worktree; verify Git diff, not a sandbox
use: 默认实现者：独自拥有测试与实现
not: 不递归派发，不改 scope 外文件
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/templates/worker.md

agentProfiles.name: 攻坚（高工）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: zhipu
harness: codex
write: assigned Write scope in worktree; auto-review allows writes
use: 协调者按需选：跨模块、并发、状态机或有证据的返工
not: 不重规划架构，不自动升级模型
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/templates/worker.md

agentProfiles.name: 审查（按察司）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: openai
harness: codex
write: task-read-only; auto-review allows writes; reconcile HEAD, tracked and untracked diff-check
use: 独立代码审查，仅风险代码，1 次裁决
not: 不审自己的改动，不设合并门禁
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/templates/reviewer.md

agentProfiles.name: 测试（独立 Red）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: openai
harness: codex
write: explicit task test paths only; auto-review allows production writes, scope is task rule
use: 仅 Review: strict 或用户明确要求独立 Red
not: 不写实现，不自己派下游
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/templates/tester.md

agentProfiles.name: 界面（将作）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: moonshot
harness: claude
write: assigned UI Write scope in worktree; verify Git diff
use: 按需做视觉、交互状态、键盘焦点与多视口
not: 不把前端改动变成强制交接
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/templates/worker.md

agentProfiles.name: 协调（尚书）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: meta
harness: claude
write: dispatch metadata only; no product writes; auto is not read-only
use: 按需薄调度与对账；默认主会话承担
not: 不改产品代码，不另建账本，不替用户答风险或授权
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/SKILL.md

agentProfiles.name: 契约审查（Neon）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: google
harness: antigravity
write: task-read-only; before/after HEAD, tracked and untracked diff-check; full-access is not a sandbox
use: R0 独立契约审查；复杂综合按需（阶段标题沿用 hanlin R0，不是 profile 身份）
not: 参与过 Proposal 即不能审该契约；不写产品或契约
brief: skills/paseo-pipeline/templates/reviewer.md

agentProfiles.name: 兼容入口（问题排查，非默认）
agentProfiles.notes:
family: openai
harness: claude
write: no default assignment; explicitly scoped task only
use: 仅旧引用兼容（保留 ID，不删除）
not: 非新增阶段，非自动备用
brief: none
